mechanism: Both drugs inhibit P-glycoprotein efflux transporter, potentially increasing loperamide CNS penetration and causing neurotoxicity; ivermectin may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of loperamide.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor closely for signs of loperamide toxicity (dizziness, drowsiness, abdominal distension); consider alternative anthelmintic if possible.
